items.title: 52222_Marshall Royal oral history interview
items.q: A fellow by the name of Johnny Mitchell (PHONETIC) was playing tenor saxophone and I played alto in the band.

ctx.x: Who else was in the band when you joined it? (inaudible)?

When I joined Curtis Moseby's band, there was, let's see, Lawrence Brown was playing trombone. Another very good trumpet player by the name of James Porter and Leo Davis was an alto saxophone player, very good. He was an ex-violin player. A fellow by the name of Johnny Mitchell (PHONETIC) was playing tenor saxophone and I played alto in the band.

Then there was a old Army man, used to play tuba. He was a tuba player in the band. They didn't have bass violin in that band. They had a tuba instead of basses. Army man by the name of Perkins Brookens (PHONETIC). And they had a -- oh, several other fellas that I can't think of in the band at this time, but it was a very good musical band and we played shows. It was a showhouse. They had a very, very good floor show there that included a line of chorus girls, which was my pride and joy, coming up as a young man,…
